name: Conceptual Physics Recurring + Assessment Resource Profile
extends: current Base Recurring + Assessment Resources PM
role: Course-specific renderer/profile layer. Learning/evidence remains owned by the current Unit Assessment Plan; canonical secure content remains owned by the finalized Bank.

summative.forms_source: finalized secure Bank active Summative form IDs, validated against contracts/base_bank_compatibility.json
summative.answer_sheet: Dedicated selected-response bubble sheet for questions 1–16; renderer must materialize 16 real .bubble-row nodes; version choices come from active form IDs only.
summative.bubble_markup_contract: Keep answer letters normal-sized and render the mark target as a separate .bubble element inside .bubble-choice; do not enlarge A/B/C/D/E by scaling one text-glyph container.
summative.student_metadata: Do not show DOK/section/internal Bank labels; hidden data attributes may remain for traceability.
summative.stale_template_guard: Rendered/reference HTML is visual evidence only. It cannot override current Bank/Framework form membership. Remove/ignore legacy V7/V8 sections, keys, selectors, navigation, and version bubbles when the active Bank contains V1–V6.
summative.figure_caption_rule: No descriptive captions beneath student-facing graphs/figures. Put explanatory wording before the representation; preserve only necessary labels inside it.

selected_response_answer_sheet.version_selector: active V1-V6 only for current profile; generate from resolved active forms

approved_final_two_pages.legacy_frgrid: CSS backward compatibility only; PROHIBITED in new Summative builds.

representation_preservation.rule: Preserve actual current secure Bank student-prompt representation markup and required local assets exactly; do not silently delete them.
representation_preservation.no_stale_visual_invention: Do not import SVG/images from an older rendered Summative if they are absent from the current secure Bank item.
representation_preservation.metadata_is_not_markup: A representation metadata label such as model/data does not authorize fabricated artwork.

delivery_contract.loose_html: preview/QA only; never the final user download for a requested Unit Summative build
delivery_contract.include_local_assets: Include every local figure/file referenced by the rendered Summative HTML.
delivery_contract.shared_css: Link ../../css/summative_physics.css; do not duplicate course-root CSS unless explicitly requested.
delivery_contract.pre_delivery_check: List/read ZIP contents and verify archive integrity.

summative.answer_sheet_renderer_gate: Final HTML must contain exactly 16 numbered .bubble-row nodes (1-16) inside .page.answersheet .sheetgrid; unresolved join(bubble_rows)/template expressions are prohibited.

warmups.shell: standard universal Base Recurring Warm-Up shell

exit_tickets.shell: standard universal Base Recurring Exit shell; shared exit.css unchanged
exit_tickets.print_mechanism: printExitTicket(ticketId) activates only matching .exit-print[data-source-ticket] with .print-active, then clears afterprint
exit_tickets.prohibited: document.body.dataset.printTarget or course-specific print-target CSS workaround

progress_tracker.four_goal_distribution: 2 goal cards on page 1 + 2 goal cards on page 2
progress_tracker.content: all exact supporting I-cans from ORIGINAL Unit Assessment Plan; no omission for fit
progress_tracker.css: ../../css/progress_tracker.css unchanged; use canonical compact DOM/classes rather than a custom oversized shell

review.shell: standard universal current Review/Review Practice renderer
